runners.spotlight: In need of the experience but kept on well to collar Generic close home at Kempton 17 days ago (1m); sent off favourite there so a big run was clearly expected; not weighted to confirm those placings but a key player all the same.

runners.comment: Second run better than his debut (both 1m, AW); has more to offer now switched to turf
runners.name: Al Maslool
runners.spotlight: His second run was better than his debut (both 1m on Lingfield's AW track) and he still looked in need of the experience when third last month; can step forward again now switched to turf.

runners.comment: Second, beaten a head, by Enemy Agent on debut 17 days ago (1m, AW); 7lb better off today
runners.name: Generic
runners.spotlight: Travelled better than Enemy Agent but was unable to repel his late thrust in a 1m Kempton maiden 17 days ago; has a 7lb turnaround for that head defeat today and may b able to reverse the placings.

runners.comment: Placed in two 7f runs in February; steps up in trip with further progress possible
runners.name: Master Of Keraunos
runners.spotlight: Two 7f runs in February, improving at the second time of asking; another similar step forward for the extra furlong would see him on the premises.

runners.comment: Promising 2nd on Kempton debut (1m); open to improvement and more appealing than many
runners.name: My Mate Roger
runners.spotlight: Attracted support on his Kempton debut in December (1m) and ran well for a close second of the ten runners; can do better and he is more appealing than many.

runners.comment: RPR in the low 70s in two 7f AW runs; bred to appreciate the extra furlong
runners.name: Thunderhoof
runners.spotlight: He has shaped with promise in two 7f AW events this year and he is bred to appreciate the step up in trip; each-way shout if improving for 1m.

runners.comment: Two 7f runs at Southwell last year were encouraging but he'll need much more to take this
runners.name: Strong Voice
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise in his two 7f runs at Southwell last October; the extra furlong and switch to turf will need to have a positive effect if he is to take this though.

runners.comment: Modest form in two Chelmsford novice events last year; been gelded; improvement essential
runners.name: Timely Salute
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two Chelmsford novice events as a 2yo (7f/1m); gelded since latest; improvement essential now switched to turf.

runners.comment: £42,000 half-sister to two winners; worth a market check with good claimer booked
runners.name: Sierra Sue
runners.spotlight: £42,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Roman Spring (5f/6f including AW; RPR 76) and Only In Jakarta (7f AW; 76); dam unraced half-sister to 5f Listed winner Swiss Lake; worth a market check with Jack Callan taking off a useful 5lb.

runners.comment: 45,000gns yearling; bred for further and perhaps a longer-term prospect
runners.name: Whole Lotta Rosie
runners.spotlight: 45,000gns yearling; first foal of a maiden sister to a US 1m3f Grade 2 winner; might find this trip on the sharp side on debut.

runners.comment: 1,000gns yearling; half-sister to three winners; likely best watched on debut
runners.name: Mokata
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Wheal Kitty (1m; RPR 67), Kasino (6f AW 2yo; 57) and Frasard (US 1m1f turf); useful standard to aim at and likely best watched.

runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners out of a 1m4f AW winner; tough enough task on debut
runners.name: Sharp Romance
runners.spotlight: 2,500gns foal; third foal; half-sister to winners Charming Whisper (7f-1m2f including 2yo; RPR 87) and Mister Phoenix (German 8.7f); dam 1m4f AW winner (74); she will need to be useful to make a winning debut.

17:06.race_name: TigerBet.co.uk Best Odds Guaranteed Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Well held in a French maiden and a maiden hurdle; sold £1,800 since latest; opposable
runners.name: Hengest
runners.owner: Gee Gees Racing P Gleeson & N Barnes
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a 1m1f maiden in France (for Andre Fabre); beaten 28l in a Huntingdon maiden hurdle for Jamie Snowden last month; sold for £1,800 since; best watched on stable debut.

runners.comment: Quickened smartly to win by daylight at Southwell (7f) on debut; plenty more to come
runners.name: Organise
runners.spotlight: Sent off the 11-10f for his Southwell debut (7f) in November and his supporters had few concerns as he travelled well prior to surging clear, despite evident inexperience, in the final furlong; looked a colt of considerable promise on that occasion and he holds strong claims under a penalty.

runners.comment: Made most when winning over 1m at Newcastle in February; this is tougher under a penalty
runners.name: Outback Heat
runners.spotlight: Dictated a steady pace when winning a 1m maiden at Newcastle in February; showed a willing attitude there but he will need to raise his game if he is to defy a penalty.

runners.comment: Made all for ready 7f win here last October (2nd run); more to come this year; now hooded
runners.name: Ya Karim
runners.spotlight: Confirmed the promise of his Kempton debut last September (7f) when readily making all over 7f here one month later (Pentonville 5.75l back in fifth); 1m should suit and he commands plenty of respect; hooded first time.

runners.comment: Promise in his two starts, the latest last month, but this race demands a good deal more
runners.name: Pentonville
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
runners.spotlight: Behind Ya Karim here (7f, good) on sole 2yo start; similar form when third past the post (promoted to second) at Kempton last month; improvement required.

runners.comment: 200,000gns yearling; half-brother to 2 winners in the US; has a useful standard to aim at
runners.name: Weheedd
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to US winners Astroturf (1m-8.5f AW/dirt) and Kintra (5f turf 2yo); unraced dam closely related to 1m winner Encompassing; has a useful standard to aim at on debut but still worth a market check.

runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but he may find this an insufficient test these days; blinkers return
runners.name: Twilight Jet
runners.spotlight: Now 14lb lower than when a fine second at Epsom on Derby day last June (6f, soft); in and out since then but no doubt he has the ability to feature at 0-80 level if on one of his good days; suspicion he needs slower ground to be a potent force at an easy 5f though; blinkers back on today.

runners.comment: Comes here on the back of a last-gasp Newcastle success (5f) last month; respected up 2lb
runners.name: Pixie Diva
runners.spotlight: Both her wins have come on AW, the latest when hugging the stands' rail and leading in the last stride at Newcastle (5f; blanket finish) two weeks ago, but she has run well on turf too; 2lb rise for last time shouldn't prevent another good run.

runners.comment: Winless in 2025 but retained his ability; returns off dangerous mark with his yard in form
runners.name: Brave Nation
runners.spotlight: Drew a blank in 2025 but there were some good runs in defeat and he starts this season off an 8lb lower mark than for last year's reappearance; solid third in one run at Yarmouth; best on good ground or faster; makes his seasonal return with a hood back on and with his stable in good form.

runners.comment: Ex-Hong Kong; gambled on at Southwell in February & shaped with some promise; interesting
runners.name: Golden Long
runners.spotlight: 6f winner in Hong Kong (good ground); absent for 429 days prior to his British debut at Southwell seven weeks ago, a race where he was heavily backed but missed the break and then took a fierce hold through the early part of the race; he kept on nicely at the finish with that in mind and he looks a strong contender back on turf.

runners.comment: String of good AW runs this winter; 8lb lower than for latest turf run; should go well
runners.name: Almaty Star
runners.spotlight: Ultra-reliable operator on AW, running another solid race when second to a class-dropper at Wolverhampton (5f; first time visor) last month; lesser strike-rate on turf but he is fully effective on it and he has been given a real chance by the handicapper, dropped 10lb for his last two turf defeats (in Class 3); should go well.

runners.comment: Good record over C&D; did best of the far-side group at Doncaster last time; contender
runners.name: Thunder Star
runners.spotlight: She was returning from a five-month break when finishing in midfield at Doncaster 13 days ago (5f, good to soft), a race where she tired in the final furlong but still did best of the far-side group; two wins and two seconds from her six C&D runs and she has solid claims off a fair mark.

runners.comment: Outpaced early but ran on well to win at Chelmsford on stable debut; this is a better race
runners.name: Skellig Isle
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start for her new connections when coming home 2.25l clear of her rivals in a Class 5 at Chelmsford 16 days ago (5f); she looked to be going nowhere through the first half of that race, under the pump before the field had completed a furlong, but the pace folded and she was strong at the finish; a 6lb rise and stronger opposition could find her out.

runners.comment: Closest to first win over 6f on AW; hampered in running over 1m latest; bred to do better
runners.name: Station Bar
runners.spotlight: Out of half-sister to Accidental Agent whose fine career for the yard included a Group 1 at 1m; came nearest to a win when losing out narrowly on Kempton AW (6f) in November but his first 1m run, there in March, promised more as he had anything but a clear run; can do better as 3yo.

runners.comment: Creditable handicap runs at 6f/7f; four siblings won at 1m-1m4f so new trip could suit
runners.name: Slack Bob
runners.owner: The Old Etonian Racing Syndicate II
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on turf debut (heavy); has raced on AW since, not having the cleanest of runs when a keeping-on third at Wolverhampton (7f) in January; four siblings won at between 1m and 1m4f and he looks ready for a go at 1m; shortlisted.

runners.breeder: N Hartery & Lope De Vega Syndicate
runners.comment: Minor form at 7f/1m; gelded since; should find this level more suitable; check market
runners.name: Sports Day
runners.spotlight: Minor form in 7f and 1m events as 2yo but gelded since and his pedigree suggests the return to this trip should suit, as will the switch to handicap company; interesting to see how the betting goes.

runners.comment: Keeping-on 3rd at Kempton (7f); worth another go at 1m now trying her luck in a handicap
runners.name: Blue Celestial

runners.name: Mistral St Georges

runners.comment: Runner-up in both hurdle runs and latest was at Market Rasen last month; in the mix

runners.comment: Showed promise in first two runs but was pulled up in her final start for Dan Skelton
runners.name: Whitletts

runners.comment: Still early days but she's struggled in both hurdle runs and needs a transformation
runners.name: Burning Embers
runners.owner: S T Racing Burnt Ends Partnership
runners.spotlight: Getaway mare who wasn't beaten far in her sole bumper but she's finished tailed off in two runs over hurdles (2m, good) since; with top yard and still unexposed but needs major improvement; stablemate of Jollie Dame.

runners.comment: Tailed off in both hurdle runs during the winter and can only be watched
runners.name: Ciao Bellisima
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on Wetherby debut (2m3f, soft) in December and same story when dropped to 2m at Hereford (300-1) the following month.

runners.comment: Showed promise in both bumpers runs and she looks interesting now switched to hurdling
runners.name: Elated
runners.spotlight: From a good family and she showed promise in two bumpers during the winter, more recently when third of ten at Huntingdon (2m, soft) in January; looks interesting now switched to hurdling and she needs watching in market.

runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival in sole bumper and was tailed off on hurdling debut last month

runners.comment: Struggled in both her bumpers and needs a transformation on this switch to hurdling
runners.name: Lakeview Lass

runners.comment: Well held in both bumpers and was a remote third on hurdling debut at Stratford
runners.name: Nowherenearmilan

runners.comment: Not discredited when fifth in handicap here two weeks ago; in the mix off a slipping mark
runners.name: Pink Socks
runners.spotlight: A three-time winner early in 2026, including over C&D, for Ian Williams; not discredited on just her second run for current yard when fifth in 1m handicap here two weeks ago; in the mix off a slipping mark.

runners.comment: Good second at Kempton latest, not enjoying smooth run; can go well despite a 2lb rise
runners.name: Timely Affair
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who got off the mark here in January and posted a good second of nine to Aim For The Bull in 1m Kempton handicap 17 days ago, not enjoying the smoothest of passages under 2f out; enjoys a 1lb weights pull here and can go well.

runners.comment: Winless since August 2024 but comes here in decent nick; place prospects off easing mark
runners.name: Gundogan
runners.spotlight: Winless since August 2024 but he comes here in decent nick, fifth of nine in 7f Lingfield handicap 17 days ago; place prospects off an easing mark.

runners.comment: C&D winner but below par of late; it's now 13 starts since that victory
runners.name: Ardaddy
runners.spotlight: C&D winner but below par of late, beating one in 1m handicap here two weeks ago; it's now 13 starts since that victory too.

runners.comment: Made it two wins in last three starts at Chelmsford 16 days ago; not taken lightly
runners.name: Shades Of May
runners.spotlight: Made it two wins in his last three starts in 7f handicap at Chelmsford 16 days ago; up 4lb but he's not taken lightly in his current mood.

runners.comment: Course scorer; good Wolverhampton second final run for Thomas Faulkner; not out of things
runners.name: Just King High
runners.spotlight: Course scorer who returned to form in a headgear change when second of eight in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 29 days ago on his final run for Thomas Faulkner; not out of things for his new handler.

runners.comment: In good form, third in 1m classified event here last time; ought to be thereabouts again
runners.name: Brother Dave
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with C&D victory (third one) and has continued in good form, fading late on when third of 11 in 1m classified event here last time; ought to be thereabouts again.

runners.comment: Best effort of season when third at Wolverhampton latest; can make her presence felt
runners.name: Hannahs Return
runners.spotlight: Without a victory since 2024 but she posted her best effort of the season when third of nine in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 19 days ago; she can make her presence felt off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Last of seven in Wolverhampton classified event latest; cheekpieces go on now
runners.name: Frontpagemoos
runners.spotlight: Poor maiden and she came in last of seven in 9.5f classified event at Wolverhampton 25 days ago; cheekpieces are reached for.

19:15.race_name: Conference & Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap (Div II)

runners.comment: Back to form of late, third here latest; this dual course winner is well in the mix
runners.name: Heretic
runners.spotlight: Scored twice over 1m here in 2025 and back to form of late, posting a good third of 11 in 1m handicap here three weeks ago; he's well in the mix eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Gained third win at Wolverhampton latest; this C&D scorer merits serious consideration
runners.name: Captain Pickles
runners.spotlight: Thriving in 2026 and he bagged a third success in 8.6f Wolverhampton handicap 12 days ago when overcoming a wide passage; up 3lb but this C&D scorer merits serious consideration.

runners.comment: Yet to hit top form for current yard, only eighth at Wolverhampton 29 days ago
runners.name: Drafted
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f winner in Ireland for Charles Byrnes in 2025 but yet to hit top form for his current yard, only eighth in 6f Wolverhampton handicap 29 days ago; needs to take a step forward.

runners.comment: Remains winless; cheekpieces are tried (hood also refitted) but others more persuasive
runners.name: Fort Augustus
runners.spotlight: Remains winless and he came in a below-par sixth in 7f Lingfield handicap 17 days ago; cheekpieces are tried now (hood also refitted) but others are more persuasive.

runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; off 12 months off before well-held fifth at Newcastle last month
runners.name: Turbo Command
runners.spotlight: Veteran three-time C&D winner; off 12 months before a well-held fifth of seven in 6f Newcastle handicap last month; needs to take a big step forward.

runners.comment: It's 18 starts since last victory and only ninth of 12 in 6f Kempton handicap last month
runners.name: Thomas Equinas
runners.spotlight: It's now 18 starts since his last victory and he came in only ninth of 12 in 6f Kempton handicap last month; others are preferred.

runners.comment: C&D winner; not disgraced when fifth over C&D last time; no forlorn hope
runners.name: Mickey Mongoose
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run in classified event over C&D in February and not disgraced back in handicap company when fifth over C&D following month; no forlorn hope.

runners.comment: Solid third at Newcastle last time; this course winner needs considering
runners.name: I Can Boogy
runners.spotlight: Started 2026 with 1m classified success at Newcastle and posted a solid third of 11 in similar event there (7f) last time; this course winner needs considering.

runners.comment: On a lengthy losing sequence but solid third at Wolverhampton latest; not dismissed
runners.name: Autumn Angel
runners.spotlight: On a lengthy losing sequence but she fared better than of late when third of 11 in 6f classified event at Wolverhampton 18 days ago; this C&D winner needs considering.

runners.comment: Largely in good form in 2025; back from eight months off in a change of headgear
runners.name: Mavetheforcebewivu
runners.spotlight: Yet to register a victory but she was largely in good form in 2025; returns from eight months off in a change of headgear.

runners.breeder: Highclere Stud & Mr Ilyas Emir Karadag
runners.comment: Without a victory since 2023 and he has yet to make the frame in seven starts in 2026
runners.name: Barneys Bay
runners.spotlight: Without a victory since 2023 and he has yet to make the frame in seven starts in 2026; hard to warm to.

runners.comment: String of consistent efforts on Tapeta in headgear; no surprise to see him defy a 5lb rise
runners.name: Kirkdale
runners.spotlight: String of consistent efforts on Tapeta since sporting headgear, culminating in last weekend's Wolverhampton win off 5lb lower; not a lot of luck round Newcastle prior to that and it would come as no surprise to see him follow up.

runners.comment: Surprise winner over C&D off 3lb lower in February; not convinced over 7f twice since
runners.name: Thankuappreciate
runners.spotlight: Stable yet to get rolling for the year but he was a bright spot when springing a surprise over C&D off 3lb lower in February; not entirely convinced over 7f a couple of times since and holds each-way claims.

runners.comment: Returns to handicap company on a workable mark and confidence will have been boosted
runners.name: Farandaway
runners.spotlight: Plenty of short-priced defeats before finally off the mark on his seventeenth start in a Newcastle maiden a few weeks ago; hard to know the merits of that but he returns to handicap company on a workable mark and confidence will have been boosted.

runners.comment: Another 3lb higher tonight; happiest in front; lot will hinge on how things play out early
runners.name: Early Release
runners.spotlight: Made all when winning at Kempton early last month (said to have appreciated being able to dominate); unable to get to the front down to 5f here next time and is another 3lb higher tonight; a lot will hinge on how things play out early.

runners.comment: Three wins, two seconds and a third to his name from 11 starts over C&D; shortlisted
runners.name: Jesse Luc
runners.spotlight: Three wins, two seconds and a third to his name from 11 starts over C&D; beaten as favourite (behind Farandaway) here a month ago but is on a workable mark now and one to consider back under Rossa Ryan.

runners.comment: Shown enough of late to suggest he can be a factor tonight in first-time headgear
runners.name: Fan Mail
runners.owner: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last autumn who's been showing enough round Newcastle of late to suggest he can be a factor tonight, especially if first-time headgear ekes out a little more.

runners.comment: This his time of year but arrives off the back of a string of modest efforts
runners.name: Northcliff
runners.spotlight: This his time of year, with two May wins in 2024 and a hat-trick last spring; arrives off the back of a string of modest efforts, though, the returning visor not making much difference last time.

runners.comment: Interesting to see how he goes in the market back from five months off upped 3lb
runners.name: Wish This
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who closed out last season with a narrow beating of Kirkdale off 3lb lower at Newcastle (first-time blinkers; goes in first-time cheekpieces here); interesting to see how he goes in the market back from five months off.

runners.comment: Hampered and eased off when a beaten-favourite last time; unexposed as a sprinter
runners.name: Sherlock
runners.spotlight: Hampered and eased off when a beaten-favourite last time, having previously got off the mark on his first run in a sprint (5f) off 6lb lower; unexposed as a sprinter.

20:15.race_name: Come Racing For Free 18th June Handicap

runners.comment: Back in 0-55 company and holds claims especially if he settles better in a first-time hood
runners.name: Hes An Angel
runners.spotlight: Often fluffs the start and is always reliant on luck given his run style; not had the breaks since a Wolverhampton win in January but is back into 0-55 company for the first time since and holds claims, especially if he settles better in a first-time hood.

runners.comment: Well supported ahead of his C&D comeback in February; one to consider for a yard in form
runners.name: Kamekist
runners.spotlight: Lost his way last year after a spring win for Eve Johnson Houghton off 13lb higher; well supported ahead of his C&D comeback in February, when faring much better off this mark, and is one to consider in a first-time tongue-tie for a yard going well of late.

runners.comment: Landed a sixth victory on Tapeta three weeks ago; never won off a mark quite this high
runners.name: Piperstown
runners.spotlight: Landed a sixth victory on Tapeta when going in at Wolverhampton off 3lb lower three weeks ago; never won off a mark quite this high but gives his trainer, who also run He's An Angel, a decent hand.

runners.comment: Prolific winner on Tapeta but never here; arrives in good form but high in the weights
runners.name: Fircombe Hall
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner on Tapeta but never round here; arrives in good form after two Wolverhampton victories last month, latterly off 3lb lower, but has never won on the AW off a mark quite this high; trainer also runs East Tyrone.

runners.comment: Does most racing now over 5f; typically consistent of late off a sliding mark
runners.name: Buraback
runners.spotlight: Does most racing now over 5f and hasn't won over this trip in three years; typically consistent of late, off a sliding mark, but he's only finished placed once from ten starts round here.

runners.comment: Goes well here, has slid to a fair mark and been offering more of late; player
runners.name: Man On A Mission
runners.spotlight: Most wins come on Polytrack but goes well here, has slid to a fair mark and been offering more of late; won twice before for headgear coming off (cheekpieces removed tonight) and is a player in an open handicap.

runners.comment: Will always come with risks attached given his run style; expensive to follow this year
runners.name: East Tyrone
runners.owner: Alan And David Fairhurst And P Kirby
runners.spotlight: Odds-on to miss the break and an even shorter price to pull hard; will always come with risks attached given his run style and has been expensive to follow this year; goes back to blinkers from a visor tonight for a yard also responsible for Fircombe Hall.

runners.comment: Hard to win with; essentially regressive and is some way down the pecking order
runners.name: Port Hedland
runners.spotlight: Hard to win with and made it 0-12 on the AW when well held at Wolverhampton last time; essentially regressive and is some way down the pecking order.

runners.comment: Better run in the tongue-tie, without seeing out 7f, latest gave her something to build on
runners.name: Griselda
runners.spotlight: Won three nurseries for George Scott two summers ago but has regressed sharply since, coming 26lb down the weights for her current yard; a better effort in a first-time tongue-tie, without seeing out 7f, last time gave her something to build on.

runners.comment: Regressive maiden who's finished well held in two runs back in 0-50 classified company
runners.name: Beautiful Things
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who's finished well held in two runs back in 0-50 classified company; would be a surprise winner switching from cheekpieces to a first-time visor.

runners.comment: Non-runner
runners.name: Gimmieminnie
runners.spotlight: Non-runner.
